unit: Unit 12: Everyday Life with Your Computer
title: An errand, start to finish
drDigitalIntro:
This is your assessment for this unit. No step-by-step instructions and nothing highlighted.
• You need the bus times, a recipe saved for later, and a check that the page you end on is secure.
• Do the objectives in any order.
• Open the checklist with the small arrow in the dark bar to see what is left.
• The Hint button points at where to look, not at what to click.

You are given the two places to look: **City Transit** for the bus times and **Recipe Box** for the recipe. Both are on the browser's new-tab page — finding them there, and doing the rest, is the assessment.

playgroundTask.goal: You ran the whole errand in the browser
playgroundTask.hint: An address you already know does not need a search engine. Anything you download collects behind one button in the gray row. The padlock lives at the left of the address bar.

steps.say: The bus timetable is on screen.
The recipe site is open in a tab.
The recipe is saved onto the computer.
The recipe is open and readable.
You checked whether the connection to the current page is private.

drDigitalSuccess: Timetable, download, opened it, and checked the connection — without being told where any of it was.
drDigitalHint: Everything is in the browser. Type addresses you know; use the gray row of buttons for the rest.
